_doc: Jetwing tuning (Cityscape theme), loaded over config/flight.json for courses whose vehicle is "jetwing"; a key left out keeps the flight.json value, and the rest default in js/glide.js and js/jetwing.js. FLIGHT_MODEL "jetwing": a rigid wing on the pilot's back with four small turbines. Jets off it glides like a stiffer wingsuit (LEVEL_SPEED: slowest speed that holds level flight, TRIM_SPEED: the speed of its best glide, GLIDE_RATIO), and can zoom up to ZOOM_MAX rad on spare speed. Boost spools the jets up (SPOOL_UP / SPOOL_DOWN per s) to THRUST g: the stick's centre then holds height, up climbs at up to CLIMB_MAX rad and down dives to JET_DIVE. GAMMA_P / GAMMA_RATE / GAMMA_RATE_DOWN: how hard it pulls up and noses over (rad/s), CL_MAX the most lift it can pull with when fast (falling to 1 at LEVEL_SPEED), PULL_DRAG the share of a manoeuvre's extra induced drag that's charged. VMAX: drag climbs steeply toward it, so it tops out just under. JET_TURN: arcade turn gain over a true coordinated turn; JET_ROLL_RATE the roll rate (rad/s); TOUCH_BANK / MAX_BANK the steepest bank for touch / mouse. Boost is the fuel: BOOST_DRAIN per s while burning (1 / BOOST_DRAIN s on a full meter), BOOST_HOOP refilled per hoop (1 = full), none over time; RESPAWN_BOOST: the meter back at a hoop after a crash. CRUISE is the start and respawn speed; BOOST only scales the speed effects. AP_BOOST: the attract-mode autopilot flies on the jets. JET_FREE: on the jets it rolls and loops freely, with the stunt plane's attitude core and the biplane's stick (js/aerobatic.js: ROLL_ON, OD_THRESH, KNIFE_BAND, ROLL_FADE): MAX_PITCH / MAX_ROLL / MAX_YAW the body rates (rad/s), TURN_ASSIST the bank-to-turn, JET_GRIP how fast the path swings to the nose (1/s).
